note: Official gazette no. 12 of 23 February 2025: law 25-01 on persons with specific needs, law 25-02 on waste, a decree on foreign students and individual appointments. Local authorities and communes appear only as bodies with accessibility, housing, subsidy and waste-planning duties; a law places nothing, and none of the texts concerns a connection at commune offices. The systems named (a national waste information and mapping system, a ministry platform for foreign students' applications) are outside the study's field.
